name: Chole Chat
procedure: Soak 100g black chana overnight.
Put soaked chana in pressure cooker 4 whistles on high and 3 on low.
Chop 100g onion and 70g Tomato in chopper.
After Chana is prepared mix with vegetables and add salt,spice and chat masala according to taste.
Bonus: Squeeze lemon on top.

name: White Sauce Pasta
procedure: Soak 100g Pasta with some salt in a pot and cook properly.
Simultaneously, add 20g butter in a pan and melt it.
On low heat, add 20g maida into melted butter.
On high heat, add 250g milk in 3 portions(to avoid lumps).
On low heat, add some salt and pasta seasoning.
On low heat, add cheese and mix until cheese is melted.

name: Schezwan Cheese Sandwich
procedure: Spread a cheese slice on each slice of bread.
Add 10g of schezwan to each sandwich.
Put in sandwicher.
